title: Danish State Scholarship
program_type: Danish state scholarship (tuition fee waiver, with a monthly grant towards living expenses at the Faculty of Arts and Aarhus BSS)
description: Aarhus University offers a limited number of Danish state scholarships, financed by the Danish state, to the most talented applicants from outside Europe who are liable to pay tuition fees for its Master's degree programmes. A scholarship is usually a combination of a full or partly tuition waiver and, in some faculties, a monthly grant towards living expenses, and it is assessed automatically as part of the admission application.

title: Aalborg University International Student Scholarship (tuition fee waiver and monthly stipend)
program_type: Government-financed tuition waiver plus stipend, awarded by the university
duration: Four semesters (the standard duration of a master's degree at AAU); no further stipend beyond the first two years of study
description: Aalborg University grants a small number (approximately 15 per year) of tuition-fee-waiver-plus-stipend scholarships to individually selected applicants from non-EU/EEA countries applying to fee-paying master's programmes for the September intake. The award covers the full tuition fee and pays a monthly living-expense stipend of DKK 11,225 / EUR 1,503 (2026 rate) for four semesters. There is no separate application: all non-EU applicants to a master's programme are considered automatically, and decisions are communicated by the beginning of July at the latest. title: RESDOC Doctoral Researcher Positions - Resilient and Just Systems Doctoral Project (MSCA COFUND)
program_type: Employment-based doctoral training grant (MSCA COFUND / Horizon Europe)
duration: Four years, 2027-2030, full-time (100%) fixed-term employment contract including a six-month trial period
description: RESDOC (Resilient and Just Systems Doctoral Project) is an international doctoral training project at the University of Helsinki, co-funded by the Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions COFUND scheme under Horizon Europe and the University itself. It recruits 30 doctoral researchers for four-year, 100% employment contracts running 2027-2030, at a gross salary of approximately EUR 2,900 per month including a mobility allowance, plus an annual travel allowance for conferences and secondments. title: University-funded doctoral researcher positions (University of Helsinki Doctoral School)
duration: Four years, full-time work, doctoral degree to be completed within four years
description: The University of Helsinki Doctoral School provides annual funding for full-time doctoral researcher positions across all of the University's doctoral programmes. Holders are university employees and are expected to complete a doctoral degree within four years. There is one application period each year; the 2026 period ran from 24 August to 7 September 2026, with decisions notified to applicants by the end of December 2026. Detailed general and programme-specific application instructions are published in the University's Studies Service.

title: Aalto University Excellence Scholarship (100% tuition fee waiver)
duration: Target time of the degree programme: three years full-time for a bachelor's degree and two years full-time for a master's degree
description: The Aalto University Excellence Scholarship is a merit-based, competitive tuition fee waiver awarded to non-EU/non-EEA applicants who are liable to pay Aalto tuition fees. It covers the full tuition fee for the target time of the degree programme - three years for a bachelor's degree and two years for a master's degree. Applications are made as part of the normal admission process, and only a very limited number of scholarships are awarded, with some programmes awarding none. The scholarship does not cover living costs in Finland, which students must fund themselves.

title: Tampere University tuition fee scholarship (50%) and early bird offer
program_type: Merit-based partial tuition fee scholarship and tuition fee discount
duration: For the programme duration (tuition fee scholarship); the early bird discount applies to the first year of studies only
description: Tampere University offers a limited number of merit-based tuition fee scholarships, awarded at admission to exceptionally qualified applicants. The tuition fee scholarship covers 50% of the programme tuition fees for the whole programme duration. A separate early bird offer gives all fee-paying students who did not receive a tuition fee scholarship a EUR 2,000 reduction on the first-year tuition if they accept the place and pay within three weeks. title: University of Oulu Early Bird Discount and Tuition Fee Waiver Scholarship
program_type: Programme-specific tuition fee discount and merit-based tuition fee waiver
duration: Early Bird Discount applies to the first year of studies; Tuition Fee Waiver Scholarships run from the second year onwards for the remaining study right
description: The University of Oulu does not give scholarships to first-year students. Instead, selected degree programmes offer an Early Bird Discount of 5% to 30% on the first-year tuition if the fee is paid within three weeks of the admission results being published. Tuition Fee Waiver Scholarships of 5% to 40% are available from the second year onwards, awarded to continuing students who complete at least 60 ECTS credits in the preceding academic year in line with their study plan. The university states it does not offer any scholarship covering 100% of tuition fees.
